text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Now you, mortal, raise a lamentation over Tyre,
text_cn: “人子，你应唱哀歌凭吊提洛，

text_en: and say to Tyre, which sits at the entrance to the sea, merchant of the peoples on many coastlands, Thus says the Lord God : O Tyre, you have said, “I am perfect in beauty. ”
text_cn: 向位于海口，同许多岛屿及人民通商的提洛说： 吾主上主这样说：提洛，你曾说过：我是一只完美华丽的船；

text_en: Your borders are in the heart of the seas; your builders made perfect your beauty.
text_cn: 你的领域伸入海心，你的建筑者造成了你的豪华：

text_en: They made all your planks of fir trees from Senir; they took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
text_cn: 他们用色尼尔的松柏制造了你的舷板，以黎巴嫩的香柏做了你的桅樯，

text_en: From oaks of Bashan they made your oars; they made your deck of pines from the coasts of Cyprus, inlaid with ivory.
text_cn: 以巴商的橡木做了你的橹桨，用由基廷岛运来的松柏做了嵌有象牙的甲板，

text_en: Of fine embroidered linen from Egypt was your sail, serving as your ensign; blue and purple from the coasts of Elishah was your awning.
text_cn: 用埃及的绣花麻布做了你的帆幔，作了你的旗帜，用厄里沙岛的紫色与朱色的布做了你的船蓬；

text_en: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers; skilled men of Zemer were within you, they were your pilots.
text_cn: 漆冬和阿尔瓦得的居民给你摇橹，责默尔的技工在你那里作你的舵手，

text_en: The elders of Gebal and its artisans were within you, caulking your seams; all the ships of the sea with their mariners were within you, to barter for your wares.
text_cn: 革巴耳的长老和技工在你那里修理你的漏洞。一切航海的船只和海员都到你那，交易货物。

text_en: Paras and Lud and Put were in your army, your mighty warriors; they hung shield and helmet in you; they gave you splendor.
text_cn: 波斯、路丁和普特人在你队伍中作你的军人，他们将盾牌和铜盔悬在你中间，增加你的光彩。

text_en: Men of Arvad and Helech were on your walls all around; men of Gamad were at your towers. They hung their quivers all around your walls; they made perfect your beauty.
text_cn: 阿尔瓦得和赫肋客子民围绕在你的城墙上，加玛得人在你的角楼中；他们把自己的盾，挂在四周的城墙上，使你的华丽更为圆满。

text_en: Tarshish did business with you out of the abundance of your great wealth; silver, iron, tin, and lead they exchanged for your wares.
text_cn: 塔尔史士因你的财帛丰富，作你的客商，以银、铁、锡、铅来与你交易。

text_en: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech traded with you; they exchanged human beings and vessels of bronze for your merchandise.
text_cn: 雅汪、突巴耳、默舍客和你通商，以人口和铜器与你交易货物。

text_en: Beth-togarmah exchanged for your wares horses, war horses, and mules.
text_cn: 由托加尔玛地方，有人以马、战马、骡子来交换货物。

text_en: The Rhodians traded with you; many coastlands were your own special markets; they brought you in payment ivory tusks and ebony.
text_cn: 德丹人也和你通商，许多岛民作你手下的商人，以象牙角和乌木作送给你的贡物。

text_en: Edom did business with you because of your abundant goods; they exchanged for your wares turquoise, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies.
text_cn: 阿兰人因你的出品多，也作你的客商，以紫宝石、红布、刺绣、细麻、珊瑚和红玛瑙与你交换货物。

text_en: Judah and the land of Israel traded with you; they exchanged for your merchandise wheat from Minnith, millet, honey, oil, and balm.
text_cn: 犹大和以色列地也和你通商，以米尼特谷、蜡、蜜、油和香料与你交易货物。

text_en: Damascus traded with you for your abundant goods—because of your great wealth of every kind—wine of Helbon, and white wool.
text_cn: 大马士革因你出产多，财帛丰富，也作你的客商，以赫耳朋酒和匝哈尔羊毛与你交易。

text_en: Vedan and Javan from Uzal entered into trade for your wares; wrought iron, cassia, and sweet cane were bartered for your merchandise.
text_cn: 此外丹、雅汪和乌匝耳也与你交易，以钢铁、肉桂和香菖(chāng)蒲交换你的货物。

text_en: Dedan traded with you in saddlecloths for riding.
text_cn: 德丹以骑马的坐垫和你交易。

text_en: Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your favored dealers in lambs, rams, and goats; in these they did business with you.
text_cn: 阿剌伯和刻达尔的一切酋长也作你手下的商人，以羔羊、山羊和公羊与你交换货品。

text_en: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah traded with you; they exchanged for your wares the best of all kinds of spices, and all precious stones, and gold.
text_cn: 舍巴和辣阿玛的买卖人也作你的顾客，以各种上等的香料，各种宝石和黄金和你交换货品。

text_en: Haran, Canneh, Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad traded with you.
text_cn: 哈郎、加乃、厄登和舍巴的商人，亚述和一切玛待人也与你通商。

text_en: These traded with you in choice garments, in clothes of blue and embroidered work, and in carpets of colored material, bound with cords and made secure; in these they traded with you.
text_cn: 他们在你的商场上，以华丽的衣服、朱色的外氅、刺绣、花毯、编织的结实绳索与你交易。

text_en: The ships of Tarshish traveled for you in your trade. So you were filled and heavily laden in the heart of the seas.
text_cn: 塔尔史士船只载运你的货物。 你在海上满了载，极其沉重。

text_en: Your rowers have brought you into the high seas. The east wind has wrecked you in the heart of the seas.
text_cn: 你的桨夫将你划到汪洋大海，东风将你在海中吹毁。

text_en: Your riches, your wares, your merchandise, your mariners and your pilots, your caulkers, your dealers in merchandise, and all your warriors within you, with all the company that is with you, sink into the heart of the seas on the day of your ruin.
text_cn: 你的财帛、商品、货物，你的水手、舵手、船工，同你交易的商人，在你中间的一切战士，以及在你中间所有的民众，都在你沉没之日，溺死海中。

text_en: At the sound of the cry of your pilots the countryside shakes,
text_cn: 海岸都因你舵手的狂叫声而震动。

text_en: and down from their ships come all that handle the oar. The mariners and all the pilots of the sea stand on the shore
text_cn: 所有摇橹的人、水手和航海的舵手都要离船登岸，

text_en: and wail aloud over you, and cry bitterly. They throw dust on their heads and wallow in ashes;
text_cn: 狂呼呐喊哀吊你，在头上撒灰，辗转于尘埃之中，

text_en: they make themselves bald for you, and put on sackcloth, and they weep over you in bitterness of soul, with bitter mourning.
text_cn: 并且为你而剃光了头，穿上苦衣，痛心哭泣，悲痛哀悼你。

text_en: In their wailing they raise a lamentation for you, and lament over you: “Who was ever destroyed like Tyre in the midst of the sea?
text_cn: 他们在痛苦中，向你唱哀歌，追悼你说：‘有谁相似沉没于海中的提洛？

text_en: When your wares came from the seas, you satisfied many peoples; with your abundant wealth and merchandise you enriched the kings of the earth.
text_cn: 你的货品由海中运出时，曾使许多民族满足；以你大量的财帛和货物，使陆地上的列王丰富。

text_en: Now you are wrecked by the seas, in the depths of the waters; your merchandise and all your crew have sunk with you.
text_cn: 现今你沉入海中，落在海底，你的财物和所有的人，都随着你而沉没了。’

text_en: All the inhabitants of the coastlands are appalled at you; and their kings are horribly afraid, their faces are convulsed.
text_cn: 群岛所有的居民都为你而惊骇，那里的列王都极为战栗，面带忧色。

text_en: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you; you have come to a dreadful end and shall be no more forever. ”
text_cn: 各国的商人都要嗤笑你；你竟成了恐怖的对象，且永远不复存在。”
